## Summary

Describe the change and the roadmap item or issue it addresses.

## Verification

- [ ] Focused tests added or updated where behavior changed
- [ ] `cargo fmt --check`
- [ ] `cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings`
- [ ] `cargo test --locked`
- [ ] `mix format --check-formatted` and `mix test` in `ui/`, if the dashboard changed

## Sign-off

- [ ] Every commit carries a `Signed-off-by` line (`git commit -s`), per
      [CONTRIBUTING.md](../CONTRIBUTING.md)

## Documentation

- [ ] Documentation is current, or no update is needed

## Security

- [ ] No secrets, keys, encrypted memory, or audit records are included
- [ ] This change is not a public report of a security vulnerability
